plan.title: Pendulum, dominoes and golf ball

items.name: Shelf
items.why: A level shelf 40 cm up on its legs; the dominoes and the golf ball stand on it, and its right end is the drop-off

items.name: Pendulum
items.why: Pivot 95 cm up above the shelf; pulled 40° to the left, its bob swings down and strikes the first domino near its top at the bottom of the swing

items.name: Ten dominoes
items.why: Ten standard 5 cm dominoes on the shelf. The first stands just right of the bob's lowest point.

items.name: Golf ball
items.why: Sits at the very end of the shelf, within about 1 cm of the edge, so the last domino's nudge rolls it off

items.name: Box
items.why: An open box standing on the table just right of and below the shelf's end, to catch the falling golf ball

goals.label: The pendulum hits the first domino
The golf ball lands in the box

plan.notes: The bob reaches the bottom of its swing after about 0.35 s and topples the row. The wave runs about 26 cm along the shelf. The last domino nudges the golf ball off the shelf's end, and it drops about 28 cm into the box.
assumptions: The shelf is a 63.5 cm wooden plank standing on its own legs, 40 cm above the table
The pendulum hangs from its own stand above the shelf so the bob just clears the shelf top
Standard 5 cm dominoes of equal size, since no size was given
The box stands on the table, close to the shelf's end, because the ball leaves the shelf slowly and falls almost straight down
plan.reply: I built a pendulum that swings into ten 5 cm dominoes on a 40 cm high shelf. The last domino nudges a golf ball off the shelf's end into a box on the table below.

suggestions.label: Make the drop more dramatic
suggestions.prompt: Raise the shelf to 80 cm so the golf ball falls further into the box

suggestions.label: Use growing dominoes
suggestions.prompt: Make the ten dominoes grow in size so the last one gives the golf ball a harder push

suggestions.label: Swap in a wrecking ball
suggestions.prompt: Replace the pendulum with a wrecking ball that knocks the first domino

goals.label: The golf ball lands in the box
